changes: Rule-9 self-hosting batch (WP-10c-selfhost): A/B disk creation (abdisk), OS install to disk (install), GRUB BIOS boot loader install (grub-install) all from the oc> shell - no host tools; the kernel payload travels with the boot media as a multiboot2 module (grub.cfg: module2 ... self); boot-time partition scan registers <disk>pN for every partition; mkfs.fat32 uses the Microsoft cluster-size table so 512 MiB volumes mount; oc_ab_rescan makes update --status work right after abdisk. Docs: docs/EXTENSIONS_SELFHOST.md. QEMU-verified: no-ISO boot, OTA slot B e2e, self-install chain.
